title: Add hi(name) function returning f'hi {name}'
body:
In `orgos/agile/hi.py`, define `def hi(name: str) -> str:` that returns `f'hi {name}'`. Keep it pure — no side effects, no external dependencies. Function is simple enough to verify by inspection.

**Done when:** `from orgos.agile.hi import hi; hi('there')` returns `'hi there'`.

votes.justification: The test and devsecops arguments are valid: this function is trivially pure and verifiable by inspection. I am updating my estimate to 1 point.
The function is pure and trivially verifiable by inspection or a single import call, so 1 point remains correct. No peer argument justifies increasing the estimate.
The function is pure with no I/O, dependencies, or side effects, making security risk zero; my peer's reasoning confirms this, so I hold my original estimate.
